channel.title: Institut de Recerca en Energia de Catalunya - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Institut de Recerca en Energia de Catalunya (irec.cat)

item.title: The FURTHER-Wind project starts this month - IREC
item.description: IREC is pleased to host Chen Liu as a postdoctoral researcher through a Beatriu de Pinós (BP2024) fellowship. Dr. Liu will join the Power Systems Department at IREC under the supervision of José Luis Domínguez, where he will develop his professional career in the field of offshore wind power systems, while also benefiting from advanced training in transversal skills.

item.title: IREC leads a consortium developing zero-emission maritime fuel for the Port of Barcelona - IREC
item.description: IREC has led the SUPORT consortium, which has developed and validated an innovative process to produce sustainable maritime fuels from wastewater and CO₂ generated during its treatment, in collaboration with the Port of Barcelona, Aigües de Barcelona, Cetaqua, and CIMNE.

item.title: Digital Twins to support the implementation of Positive Energy Districts - IREC
item.description: The Scale-UP MAKING PEDs project aims to support Positive Energy District (PED) implementation across urban areas, addressing both neighbourhood specific and city-wide applications, by developing data-driven Digital Twins.

item.title: Advancing Open Science at IREC - IREC
item.description: IREC has been able to improve its research data management systems deploy its Open Science strategy thanks to the María de Guzmán funding from FECYT.

item.title: Jordi Puigcorbé appointed as the new Director of IREC - IREC
item.description: Jordi Puigcorbé appointed as IREC’s new Director from 9 February 2026. He succeeds Professor Joan Ramon Morante, who steps down on retirement.

item.title: IREC Joins #científiques2026 on International Day of Women and Girls in Science - IREC
item.description: IREC joins #científiques 2026 on 11 February, bringing women scientists into classrooms across Catalonia to inspire students and promote gender equality in STEM.

item.title: Oxhyd is launched, the Catalan spin-off revolutionising hydrogen technologies with advanced solutions - IREC
item.description: Oxhyd Energy S.L. is officially launched as a new technology startup created in Barcelona as a spin-off of the Catalonia Institute for Energy Research (IREC) and the Catalan Institution of Research and Advanced Studies (ICREA). The company aims to transform the generation, use and storage of renewable hydrogen to accelerate the decarbonisation of the industrial sector with global impact.

item.title: IREC contributes to the innovation ecosystem presented at MWC - IREC
item.description: IREC has once again taken part in the Mobile World Congress (MWC) 2026, held from 2 to 5 March at Fira Gran Via, Barcelona. Recognized as the world’s largest and most influential connectivity event, MWC brings together global industry leaders, startups, research centers, and policymakers to shape the future of digital technologies.

item.title: IREC and ICN2 contribute to new insights into high-entropy electrocatalysts - IREC
item.description: The article, “Bringing Order to Chaos in High-Entropy Electrocatalysts” (DOI link here), authored by Dr. Jing Yu, Dr. Ren He, Dr. Neus G. Bastús, ICREA Prof. Jordi Arbiol and ICREA Prof. Andreu Cabot, is part of the journal’s special issue on emerging directions in energy research.

item.title: IREC celebrates “THE Day” highlighting success in european projects and innovation - IREC
item.description: Today, March 20, 2026, IREC held THE Day event, entitled “European Projects Coordinated by IREC: Sharing Knowledge, Experience and Success” at Parc Tecnològic Barcelona Activa in the framework of the nationally funded project TransHEner3.0.
